slides.label: Myth vs fact
slides.headline: Myth: if the builder cancels, *your deposit is gone*.
slides.body: It should come back under the agreement, and Tarion protects it within limits. What you can lose is time and the market.

caption:
A real fear, but not how it works. 👀

🔐 Your agreement should return the deposit on termination
🛡️ Tarion covers freehold deposits within limits: 10% up to $100,000 over $600,000, $60,000 at or below
📈 What you don't get back: the market you waited through
🏗️ The builder's track record matters as much as the floor plan

slides.label: Tarion warranty
slides.headline: Every new Ontario home comes with *1, 2 and 7 years* of warranty.
slides.body: 1 year for work and materials, 2 years for major systems and water, 7 years for major structural defects.

caption:
The warranty comes with the home. The deadlines are on you. 🛡️

1️⃣ One year: defects in work and materials
2️⃣ Two years: plumbing, heating, electrical and water penetration
7️⃣ Seven years: major structural defects
🗓️ Claims run on forms and windows, so diarise them at closing

slides.label: Myth vs fact
slides.headline: Myth: you have to *pick one* HST rebate.
slides.body: Federal and Ontario rebates cover different parts of the HST. An eligible buyer can claim both.

caption:
Two programs, not alternatives. 🧾

🇨🇦 Federal first-time buyer rebate: the 5% portion, up to $50,000
🏛️ Ontario enhanced rebate: the 8% portion, up to $80,000
➕ The Ontario top-up is reduced by any federal rebate you claim
